GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 004 (15 Jan 47) CPC/FP
(SCAPIN-1473)
APO 500
15 January 1947
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Ownership of Branches in Japan of Companies with Head Offices Abroad.
1. The Imperial Japanese Government is directed to issue an ordinance requiring all branches or agencies in Japan of firms with head offices outside of Japan to submit lists of all stockholders of their firms as of 14 August 1945.
2. The report will show their nationality, the number of shares each holds, and the total outstanding shares of the corporation. In each case the stockholders’ lists will include a statement as to the percentage of the companies’ total outstanding shares held by Japanese nationals.
3. The ordinance will carry a penalty clause for non-compliance. The report will be submittd to General Headquarters, Supreme commander for the Allied Powers, by 3 February 1947.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY.
Colonel, AGD.
Adjutant General.
